"No Build" Alternative.
Under this plan, the remaining structures would be cleared and the entire area of Parcils 2, 3, and 4 would be landscaped to include grass, trees, and shrubs. This alternative includes neither extensive development for recreational purposes nor, any street network or traffic circulation improvements.
